title: Repeated input-head movement
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. For any direction flag $neg$, blank flag $bl$, and natural number $a$, applying the selector-directed step $a$ times yields the configuration obtained from $c$ by applying the corresponding clamped input-head move $a$ times to its input-head position; all other components of $c$ are unchanged.
